title: Six-domain AI skills and competencies framework for PK-12 learners
description: The brief presents PK-12 learner AI competencies across six domains: technical knowledge, practical implementation, ethical evaluation, analytical skills, interpersonal and communication skills, and adaptive skills. Sample competencies include "Using age-appropriate AI tools effectively for learning tasks" and cross-referencing AI outputs with reputable sources. The framework draws on EDSAFE AI Alliance, CSTA & AI4K12, ISTE, Kapor Foundation, and Mills et al. sources, and the brief stresses AI literacy builds on foundational digital competencies already embedded in PK-12 curricula rather than a new skill set from scratch.
requirements: Instruction must be developmentally appropriate for learners to meaningfully engage with the concepts
constraints: The field is still developing evidence-based recommendations for learner AI literacy
target_learning_goals: Understand, evaluate, and effectively use AI tools as appropriate across learning, work, and civic contexts
examples: Appendix D connects foundational skills such as early data literacy lessons to understanding how AI systems work and make decisions
